metadata.description: Tmux-based supervision and orchestration tooling for Claude Code and Codex CLI agents.

plugins.name: tmux-agent-tools
plugins.description: Run Claude Code or Codex CLI as controllable, supervised tmux sessions with an inline-vs-worker delegation gate, start/resume, send, wait, capture, status/doctor/setup, result files, approval gates, and multi-agent pair/team orchestration.

plugins.name: tmux-agent
plugins.description: Function-hook mod for tmux-agent-tools: dispatches a worker from an MCP tool and wakes this session when its result — or its launch failure — lands, so a supervised worker never finishes into silence. Needs CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1; see mods/tmux-agent/README.md.
